outcome: neonatal morbidities (impression marks, convulsions, hyperbilirubinemia, subconjunctival hemorrhage, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, facial palsy)
maternal morbidities (extended episiotomy, atonic PPH, cervical tear, perineal tear, traumatic PPH, vulvovaginal hematoma, paraurethral tear)
cohort: 92 patients who delivered by outlet forceps at Jawaharlal Nehru Hospital and Research Centre, Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, India
finding: Outlet forceps delivery had low rates of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, comparable to normal delivery.
